source_text: Ῥουστικὸς ἔπαρχος εἶπεν· Ποῦ συνέρχεσθε; Ἰουστῖνος εἶπεν· Ἔνθα ἑκάστῳ προαίρεσις καὶ δύναμίς ἐστι. Πάντως γὰρ νομίζεις ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ συνέρχεσθαι ἡμᾶς πάντας; Οὐχ οὕτως ἔχει· διότι ὁ θεὸς τῶν Χριστιανῶν τόπῳ οὐ περιγράφεται, ἀλλὰ ἀόρατος ὢν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν πληροῖ καὶ πανταχοῦ ὑπὸ τῶν πιστῶν προσκυνεῖται καὶ δοξάζεται. Ῥουστικὸς ἔπαρχος εἶπεν· Εἰπέ, ποῦ συνέρχεσθε ἢ εἰς ποῖον τόπον ἀθροίζεις τοὺς μαθητάς σου; Ἰουστῖνος εἶπεν· Ἐγὼ ἐπάνω μένω τινὸς Μαρτίνου τοῦ Τιμοθίνου βαλανείου καὶ παρὰ πάντα τὸν χρόνον τοῦτον (ἐπεδήμησα δὲ τῇ Ῥωμαίων πόλει τοῦτο δεύτερον) καὶ οὐ γινώσκω ἄλλην τινὰ συνέλευσιν εἰ μὴ τὴν ἐκείνου. Καὶ εἴ τις ἐβούλετο ἀφικνεῖσθαι παρ᾽ ἐμοί, ἐκοινώνουν αὐτῷ τῶν τῆς ἀληθείας λόγων. Ῥουστικὸς εἶπεν· Οὐκοῦν ἄρα σὺ Χριστιανὸς εἶ; Ἰουστῖνος εἶπεν· Ναί, Χριστιανός εἰμι.
orientation: The prefect Rusticus questions Justin about where Christians assemble, and Justin explains that God is not confined to place and describes his lodging in Rome.
pass_a_gloss: The prefect Rusticus said: Where do you assemble? Justin said: Where choice and ability is for each. For do you suppose that we all assemble at the same place? It is not so. Because the God of the Christians is not circumscribed by place, but being unseen he fills the heaven and the earth and everywhere is worshiped and is glorified by those who believe. The prefect Rusticus said: Tell, where do you assemble or into what place do you gather your learners? Justin said: I stay above a certain bathhouse of Martinus son of Timothinus and during all this time, for I have visited the city of the Romans this second time, and I know no other assembly except that of that man. And if anyone wished to come to me, I was sharing with him the teachings of the truth. Rusticus said: Then therefore are you a Christian? Justin said: Yes, I am a Christian.

keeps literal spatial limit verb and dative of place
rejected: is not confined to one location

choices.why: brief glossary fixes logos as teaching, plural as teachings
literal sense of one who learns, avoids church office overtone

pass_b_english: Rusticus the prefect asked, "Where do you meet?" Justin answered, "Wherever each person chooses and is able. You surely suppose we all gather in the same place? It is not so. The God of the Christians is not circumscribed by place. He remains unseen, yet he fills heaven and earth, and everywhere he is worshiped and glorified by believers."

Rusticus the prefect said, "Tell me, where do you meet, and in what place do you gather your learners?" Justin answered, "I lodge above the bathhouse of Martinus son of Timothinus. I have stayed there through all this time, and this is my second stay in the city of Rome. I know no other meeting except the one there. Whenever anyone wished to visit me, I shared the teachings of the truth with him."
Rusticus asked, "So you are a Christian?" Justin answered, "Yes, I am a Christian."
